data.name: Mashal
data.gender_notes: Mashal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A symbol of guidance, light, and enlightenment. The name Mashal carries the meaning “Torch, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashal usually hope their child will grow to embody torch, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran mentions light as a metaphor for knowledge and wisdom. Mashal embodies the pursuit of truth and understanding.
data.etymology: Mashal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Torch, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mashal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مشعل
in_arabic.meaning: مشعل تعني نور أو ضوء يوجه في الظلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشعل مشتق من الفعل 'مشع' الذي يعني الإنارة والإضاءة في الظلام، ويرمز إلى الهداية والنور الذي يضيء الطريق في الحياة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر النور والهداية في عدة آيات، مثل 'وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ' (إبراهيم:35)، حيث يُشير إلى أن الله يهدي عباده ويضيء لهم طريق الحياة.

in_urdu.name: مشعل
in_urdu.meaning: مشعل کا مطلب ہے روشنی یا اندھیروں میں رہبری کرنے والا نور
in_urdu.long_meaning: مشعل نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'مشع' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے روشن کرنا یا روشنی دینا، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم کردار رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نور اور ہدایت کی علامت ہے، قرآن مجید میں نور اور ہدایت کے متعلق کئی آیات ہیں، جیسے 'وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا كَمَثَلِ الْخَشَاشِ الَّذِي يَقْصِدُهُ الرِّيحُ الشَّدِيدَةُ' (فاطر:41)، جو منافقین اور کفار کی مثال دیتا ہے جو اندھیروں میں بھٹکتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मशअल
in_hindi.meaning: मशअल का अर्थ है प्रकाश या अंधकार में मार्गदर्शन करने वाला प्रकाश
in_hindi.long_meaning: मशअल नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश या उजाला करना, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक है, कुरआन में कई जगहों पर प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि 'وَلِيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصَ اللَّهُ بِالْفَضْلِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ' (آل عمران:144), जहां यह बताया गया है कि भगवान अपने सेवकों को सही रास्ते पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مشعل
in_pashto.meaning: مشعل د هدایت او رڼا په تیارو کې د لارښودنې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: مشعل نوم د عربي کلمې 'مشع' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رڼا یا روښنايي ورکول دي، دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې مهم دی ځکه چې د هدایت او رڼا نښه ده، په قرآن کريم کې د رڼا او هدایت په اړه ډیری آیتونه دي، لکه 'وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كَمَثَلِ الْأَثَاثِ الَّذِي أُوتِيَ النُّورُ' (البقرة:257)، چیرته چې د مومنانو بيلګه ورکړل شوې ده چې د الله په لارښودنې سره سم سمه لاره غوره کوي.

in_english.name: Mashal
in_english.meaning: Mashal means light or guidance in darkness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mashal is derived from the Arabic root 'مَشَعَ' (masha'a), which means to light up or illuminate. In Islamic tradition, light (nur) is a significant symbol representing guidance and wisdom. The Quran mentions light and guidance in various verses, such as 'And indeed, We have made the Quran easy to understand, and We have sent it down as a reminder' (Kamar: 39), indicating the illuminating role of divine guidance. The name Mashal embodies the concept of leading through darkness, symbolizing enlightenment and spiritual guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mashal" is derived from the Arabic word "mašálah," which means a torch, a beacon, or a guiding light. Culturally, this name signifies a person who provides guidance, acts as a role model, or serves as an inspiration to those around them, much like a beacon of light leading the way in the dark.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the spiritual significance of the name "Mashal" is deeply rooted in the concept of being a beacon of truth and guidance from Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is often referred to as a "Mashal," guiding the ummah (Muslim community) through his teachings, example, and compassion. Additionally, the eternal light of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is a reminder that eternity and truth come from Allah. The name Mashal serves as a reminder to always strive towards truth and to be a source of guidance for others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Torch, Light" symbolizes A symbol of guidance, light, and enlightenment.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mashal serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of torch, light.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mashal was a 13th century Persian poet. The name Mashal carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mashal was a prominent figure in Persian literature during the Ilkhanate period.
